name: jo-wolff-plugins
description: What an agent's output is made of, what shape it arrives in, when an agent may write code, and whether a thing is worth building at all: published for anyone to install.

plugins.name: output-types
plugins.description: Label only receipted facts, as CLAIM or CITE with the receipt that earns the label, and leave the rest unlabeled; a Stop check warns about any label that has no receipt.

plugins.name: i-have-audhd
plugins.description: How to write to someone who is ADHD and autistic: the rules, the research behind each one, and a Stop hook that warns when a message buries what the reader needs.

plugins.name: paired-coding
plugins.description: Pair with an agent one change set at a time: a card names the decision in each change, you agree in conversation, and a gate at the tool boundary refuses every write outside the agreed set.

plugins.name: ask-graham
plugins.description: Decide whether a new idea is worth building, with one engineer's stated judgment and one verdict. Runs on /ask-graham or "should we build X?", and on every new idea if you opt in.

plugins.name: reminders-review
plugins.description: Go through your open Apple Reminders one at a time with an agent: it answers, confirms before acting, and closes a reminder only when you say yes. macOS, via remindctl.

plugins.name: pattern-check
plugins.description: Before big work in a repository, make the agent find the existing pattern for each new piece and record reuse, replace or new; hooks hold writes, commits and PRs until that receipt exists.

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: A durable record of the questions an agent asks you and the choices it makes without asking, in one SQLite file; hooks keep every question, answer and decision on a row and gate a push on it.

plugins.name: as2-skills
plugins.description: The 22 engineering skills of agent-system 2.0, vendored from four upstream skill packs at pinned releases, with frontmatter claude.ai accepts. Skills only, no hooks.

plugins.name: plugin-kit
plugins.description: Start a new plugin that meets this repository's test bar on day one: ask the agent to create or scaffold one. Also keeps the shared libraries and release reviewers the other plugins vendor.

plugins.name: ctx-watch
plugins.description: Notice when the ctx daemon is dead, unsupervised or stale, or its semantic index is not ready; repair it, and say so at session start and in a macOS popup from a launchd timer.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Teach an agent the brief a subagent is handed, then gate on it: a spawn whose brief lacks a required section is refused with that section to fill in. Ships the general agents and guards.

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: Keep a long session's state across compaction: a snapshot saved before it and restored after, a liveness line on every start, and a handoff skill for what no hook can derive.

plugins.name: brb
plugins.description: Type brb and walk away: the agent keeps working, every ask waits in a digest, only an on-fire finding comes through at once, and back prints the digest and ends the hold.
